notes.title: The Playtest is coming soon!
notes.content:
Attention Exoforgers!

Exoforge, a third-person drop-in drop-out multiplayer adventure, is arriving on Steam soon. But before it does we need YOUR help!

We don’t want to develop Exoforge without direct player input. That’s why we’re inviting players who want to help forge the future of a game created by just one man.

Protect yourself and your squad against hoards of enemies while you mine for precious resources to craft with. Work together to gather as much as possible and return to your ship with all you’ve fought for.
Players can already expect a co-op experience with friends, featuring combat, character customization, weapon and gear crafting, resource mining, and vehicle customization!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45087862/c3efd9923a5334bf35404062d3e7865b98deb760.gif[/img]

[h3]When and where[/h3]
The Playtest will take place on Steam from [b]September 20th to 24th[/b]. Exoforge will be available for four days, allowing you to enjoy it with friends and provide feedback to improve our game.

[h3]How to get access [/h3]
Head on over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623630/?snr=1_5_9__205]Steam page[/url] and sign up! As easy as that, you’ll get notified when the Playtest begins. For more information please head over to our official Exoforge Discord.

[h3]Feedback[/h3]
We’re looking for feedback on Exoforge, including ideas, content, and any changes you’d like to see to make it better. Feedback can be shared on the official [url=https://discord.com/channels/1090700144229498890/1267460174667583559]Discord[/url] server, so don’t forget to join!

[h3]Private Playtest[/h3]
This is a closed Playtest, we ask that players do not share videos, streams, or images at this time.

Thank you for reading and hope to see you in the playtest! 

Continue below for the full Playtest F.A.Q and join our [url=https://discord.com/channels/1090700144229498890/1267460174667583559]Discord[/url] to ask anything else!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45087862/6ae03e2a0a2e51b0074a2239536766c5c2a0893b.gif[/img]
[h2]
Exoforge
Playtest F.A.Q[/h2]

A couple of things to expect while playtesting Exoforge.

Exoforge is a work in progress, which means everything you see is subject to change, and some features are not yet fully completed. Please keep this in mind while playing, and note that these features will be completed shortly after the playtest:

[list]
[*] Hosting options not currently available
All games will be joinable by others until hosting options are available
Hosts will have the ability to password lock games, tools to kick players, and set how many players can join a game. These will happen after the playtest.[/list]
[list]
[*]Resolution settings are currently not available
The resolution will default to your desktops. If you run into performance issues try turning down any 4k resolution settings.[/list]
[list]
[*] No camera sensitivity slider
The camera’s sensitivity is currently set and cannot be changed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Vaults and Cargo in games are not private
If you invite players to your game they can remove items from the vaults and cargo in your base and ship. Lockers will be added after the playtest. These will be private.[/list]

All of these issues will be fixed shortly following the playtests! For all other bugs and feedback please report them in [url=https://discord.com/channels/1090700144229498890/1267460174667583559]Discord[/url] in #submit-a-bug and #feedback.

[h3]Dates the Playtest is running[/h3]

[b]September 20th - 24th[/b]

[h3]Can I play after September 24th?[/h3]

After the 24th Exoforge will not be playable until further notice

[h3]Platforms[/h3]

Windows PC via Steam

[h3]How to get Access? [/h3]

Head on over to the url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623630/?snr=1_5_9__205]Exoforge Steam page [/url] and click Sign up! You’ll get notified when the playtests begin.

[h3]Available Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Co-op Gameplay
[*] Character customization
[*] Vehicle customization
[*] Weapon & Gear crafting
[*] Mining
[/list]
[h3]Can I play with friends?[/h3]

Yes! Take on the hoards with up to 6 friends 

[h3]Couch Co-op or Online?[/h3]

Only online co-op is available

[h3]Can I stream?[/h3]

While features are still in the early phases we ask that no one stream this playtest

[h3]Feedback & Bug Reports
[/h3]
To give your feedback and report bugs please head over to the Exoforge official [url=https://discord.com/channels/1090700144229498890/1267460174667583559]Discord[/url]

[h3]Minimum Requirements [/h3]
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS *: Windows 7
Processor: Intel i5 or equivalent
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia 1000 series or AMD equivalent with at least 6 GB of VRAM
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 4 GB available space
Sound Card: NA
VR Support: No
Additional Notes: The game is built using Unreal Engine 5 with Nanite and Lumen

For all other questions head on over to the [url=https://discord.com/channels/1090700144229498890/1267460174667583559]Discord[/url]
